headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 26, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros suffered a shutout loss to the Detroit Tigers, while the Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Texas Rangers edged the Toronto Blue Jays in a thrilling 5-4 matchup.

Top MLB news saw the Astros fall to the Tigers in a shutout, with James Outman leading the Astros' offense with a home run and three RBIs. The Reds took down the Pirates with Noelvi Marte hitting his fourth home run of the season. The Nationals fell to the Orioles in a 1-3 showdown, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 6.1 innings of work. The Rangers edged the Blue Jays in a 5-4 victory, with Nathan Eovaldi earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless relief.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Hoby Milner (appendicitis), Jesús Sánchez (right ankle sprain), Daniel Susac (low back strain), Phil Maton (right knee tendinitis), Marcelo Mayer (bone stress reaction to the left ulna), Robert Suarez (right forearm tightness), Wenceel Pérez (left orbital fracture), and Tony Santillan (left oblique strain).

The MLB trade market has been active, with the Athletics acquiring Hayden Juenger from the Blue Jays, the Cubs acquiring David Peterson from the Mets, and the Astros acquiring Marcus Brown from the Nationals.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall to Tigers in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros suffered an 8-0 loss to the Detroit Tigers, marking a tough outing for the visiting team. James Outman led the Astros' offense with a home run and three RBIs, while Keider Montero pitched a strong 7.0 innings for the Tigers, allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Pirates 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Noelvi Marte leading the offense. Marte hit his fourth home run of the season, a line drive to left center field, scoring Sal Stewart.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Orioles in 1-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 1-3 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 6.1 innings of work. Rogers struck out 7 batters and allowed just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers took down the Toronto Blue Jays 5-4, with Nathan Eovaldi earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless relief. Justin Foscue led the Rangers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured an 8-6 victory over the Detroit Tigers in a closely contested matchup. Jeremy Peña and Isaac Paredes were among the impact hitters for their respective teams.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Red Sox in Boston**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox defeated the New York Yankees 4-1, handing the Yankees their latest loss. Impact players for the Red Sox included Max Schuemann, Masataka Yoshida, and Marcelo Mayer.

top_news.title: **Cubs LHP Hoby Milner Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Chicago Cubs left-handed pitcher Hoby Milner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to appendicitis, effective retroactive to June 26, 2026.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire Hayden Juenger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays traded right-handed pitcher Hayden Juenger to the Athletics in exchange for catcher Owen Carapellotti.
